config.title: Berlin Film Festivals in Autumn 2026 - FAQ
config.subtitle: Dates, screening languages and how to choose one cinema night.

items.q: Which Berlin film festivals run in autumn 2026?
items.a: This guide tracks six confirmed windows: Fantasy Filmfest from 2 to 9 September, Festival of Animation Berlin from 8 to 11 October, Ukrainian Film Festival from 14 to 18 October, INTERFILM and Italian Film Festival from 10 to 15 November, and Punkfilmfest from 3 to 6 December.

items.q: Can I assume Berlin film-festival screenings are in English?
items.a: No. A festival can be international without offering one consistent spoken or subtitle language. Read the individual screening listing before booking.

items.q: What should I check on a festival screening page?
items.a: Check the film title, venue, exact start time, spoken language, subtitle information, ticket terms and any advertised introduction or Q&A. Reopen the page on the day in case details change.

items.q: What do OV and OmU mean on Berlin cinema listings?
items.a: They are labels you may see on individual German cinema listings, but the exact language and subtitle information on that screening page is the important part. Do not make the decision from an abbreviation alone.

items.q: How should I plan a Berlin cinema evening?
items.a: Choose one confirmed screening, save its address, check the live route on the day and keep the rest of the evening in the same area. A cinema night does not need a citywide itinerary around it.
